# Bundled browser dependencies

These versioned distributions are served locally for offline desktop and web use.

- Chart.js 4.4.1: `chart.umd.min.js`, MIT, `LICENSE.chartjs.txt`
  Source: https://github.com/chartjs/Chart.js/tree/v4.4.1
- hls.js 1.5.17: `hls.min.js`, Apache-2.0, `LICENSE.hlsjs.txt`
  Source: https://github.com/video-dev/hls.js/tree/v1.5.17

No runtime CDN connection is required. Update the distribution, license and
template reference together when upgrading a dependency.
